prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: 1024x1024 marketplace plugin icon
Primary request: Create a premium minimal bitmap icon for exact-state Git review, stacked delivery, and safe recovery workflows.
Subject: one bold branching path passing through three aligned checkpoints and ending inside a restrained safety ring; the silhouette should suggest review flow, dependent changes, and recovery without copying a forge logo.
Style/medium: polished modern app icon, vector-friendly but rendered as a high-quality bitmap, flat geometric foreground with subtle dimensional polish.
Composition/framing: centered, one dominant readable silhouette, generous safe area, no small details, readable at 32x32.
Scene/backdrop: full-bleed rounded-square app-icon background built around deep blue #173F5F with a restrained teal-to-indigo gradient.
Color palette: warm white primary path with mint and coral checkpoint accents meeting WCAG non-text contrast.
Materials/textures: crisp solid shapes, subtle soft highlights, no busy texture, no photo material, no UI screenshot.
Text (verbatim): none.
Constraints: no visible letters, words, numbers, code, brand logos, mascots, tiny badges, thin-line illustration, product UI, watermark, or private names.
Avoid: GitHub or GitLab trademark imitation, generic Git branch mark, object collage, complex scene, skeuomorphic clutter, low contrast, or text inside the icon.
checks: save the selected image into the plugin workspace as assets/icon.png
inspect the image at 1024, 64, and 32 px
reject visible text, letters, tiny details, screenshots, photos, watermarks, proprietary logos, or low contrast
wire interface.composerIcon and interface.logo only after the bitmap exists
